# device42_certificate (Datasource)

Reseach certificate using different parameters.

## Exemple 

```hcl
data "device42_certificate" "searchCertificate" {
    name = "myNewCertificate"
}

data "device42_certificate" "searchCertificate2" {
    certificate_id = 1
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `certificate_id` (Number) ID of the certificate.
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate (matches issued_to).

### Computed

- `content_commitment_usage` (Boolean) Content commitment usage flag.
- `crl_sign_usage` (Boolean) CRL sign usage flag.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Any custom fields that will be used in device42.
- `data_encipherment_usage` (Boolean) Data encipherment usage flag.
- `days_to_expiry` (Number) Number of days until the certificate expires.
- `decipher_only_usage` (Boolean) Decipher only usage flag.
- `digital_signature_usage` (Boolean) Digital signature usage flag.
- `encipher_only_usage` (Boolean) Encipher only usage flag.
- `extended_key_usage` (String) Extended key usage of the certificate.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issued_by` (String) Issuer of the certificate.
- `issued_to` (String) Certificate subject common name (CN).
- `key_agreement_usage` (Boolean) Key agreement usage flag.
- `key_cert_sign_usage` (Boolean) Key certificate sign usage flag.
- `key_encipherment_usage` (Boolean) Key encipherment usage flag.
- `parent_cert` (String) Parent certificate name.
- `san` (String) Subject alternative names of the certificate.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number of the certificate.
- `signature_algorithm` (String) Signature algorithm of the certificate.
- `signature_hash` (String) Signature hash of the certificate.
- `subject` (String) Subject of the certificate.
- `valid_from` (String) Validity start date of the certificate.
- `valid_to` (String) Validity end date of the certificate.
- `vendor` (String) Vendor of the certificate.
- `version` (String) Version of the certificate.
